items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I used to know him. Used to come in to sit down and jam on 52nd Street when he was in town...

ctx.x: Was that an enjoyable recording session for you?

Oh yeah, sure. Very much. To be playing with that type of person with a 'miscellaneous' instrument for sure. It couldn't be beat with that clientele, man. Those guys -- the greatest. Yeah, I was happy to be there. I didn't have a chance to play nothin' much...
